name: Simon Wright
office: Covina-Valley Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 4

items.text: Simon Wright is a member of the Covina-Valley Unified School District governing board, representing Trustee Area 4, and serves as its clerk. He joined the board in 2022. He owns a real estate property management company. During his 2022 campaign, he advocated for ways to address learning loss from the COVID-19 pandemic and for greater transparency and communication. He also said his private-sector experience analyzing budgets and making data-driven decisions would help the board.
